pages.text: The Blacksmith's Anvil is a block used to crush, smash, work or even repair items. You can place items on to it with a right click. You must then left click the block with a Blacksmith's Hammer. Eventually you will have hit it enough that the new item, or repaired item will have been worked.
pages.title: Blacksmith's Anvil

pages.text: You'll notice it is done when you see a big puff of smoke. You can then right click it again, to get the result. In order to use the anvil you will need 1 XP at least. If you are repairing you will need enough to repair it.
